tests.name: quoted_comma_gap
tests.note: accepted wrongly as 1:"a:b" — no quoted CSV

weaknesses.title: SYS READ OR miss sets OK=1; only READ_OK=0 signals absence
weaknesses.detail: Soft optional plate load with OR fallback leaves OK=1 so IF OK==0 never sees a miss. Agents must check READ_OK. Without that, missing CSV looks like empty success and REQUIRE falls through to 'import thin' instead of 'no csv'.
weaknesses.repro: SYS READ OR missing OR ""; PRINT_JSON OK READ_OK → OK=1 READ_OK=0

weaknesses.title: No quoted-CSV awareness — CUT splits inside quotes
weaknesses.detail: Real CSV fields like "a,b" break into multiple columns. Import accepted row 1:"a:b" for input 1,"a,b",ok. Forces shell/csvkit for any non-trivial export.
weaknesses.repro: printf '1,"a,b",ok\n' | CUT by comma → wrong name/status fields

weaknesses.title: CUT 0-based vs COLUMN 1-based easy off-by-one
weaknesses.detail: CUT n=1 is second field; COLUMN n=1 is first. Agents mixing forms mis-map columns silently.
weaknesses.repro: CUT a,b,c , 1 → b; COLUMN a,b,c , 1 → a

weaknesses.title: EMPTY vs BLANK not obvious for validation
weaknesses.detail: EMPTY is zero-length only; " " fails EMPTY but passes until BLANK checked. Two probes required for whitespace-only cells.

weaknesses.title: TRIM still not in forms/search
weaknesses.detail: Carry-over discovery gap; whitespace cells handled via BLANK instead.

workarounds: After SYS READ OR always branch on READ_OK (or EXIST first)
Reject quoted CSV or pre-normalize with shell; document simple CSV only
Validate with both EMPTY and BLANK for required text fields
LET bag = LAST after every PUSH
language_gaps: Quoted CSV / RFC4180 field split form
READ OR documentation that OK stays 1 on soft miss
Unified field(n) with explicit base flag
